_note: Items with no Skyrim record (Skyrim's weapons and armour come from data/game). cat: potion, food, misc or quest. heal is Health restored when used; quest items cannot be dropped or sold; read is the text shown when one is read, and readFlag a story flag set by reading it. Weights and values follow Skyrim's nearest item (a Linen Wrap for a bandage, Skyrim's food for food).

Bandage.name: Bandage
Bandage.desc: Linen, boiled clean. Stops the bleeding and restores 20 Health.

GoatCheese.name: Goat Cheese
GoatCheese.desc: Nadira's. The best on the coast, people say.

Salt.name: Salt Pile
Salt.desc: Coarse grey salt from the Saltreach pans.

Torch.name: Torch
Torch.desc: Pitch-soaked rag on a stick. Held in the off hand; lights the dark. L lights or puts it out.

IronOre.name: Iron Ore
IronOre.desc: Smelt two into an Iron Ingot.

CorundumOre.name: Corundum Ore
CorundumOre.desc: With Iron Ore, smelts into a Steel Ingot.

OrichalcumOre.name: Orichalcum Ore
OrichalcumOre.desc: Smelt two into an Orichalcum Ingot.

Hide.name: Animal Hide
Hide.desc: Tan it at a tanning rack for Leather.

Leather.name: Leather
Leather.desc: Cut into strips at a tanning rack, or used to make and mend hide and leather armour.

CarvedGull.name: Carved Gull
CarvedGull.desc: Tavi made it. One wing is crooked because she hit it.
CarvedGull.read: A gull, cut from driftwood with a borrowed knife. One wing is crooked. On the bottom, scratched with a nail: TAVI.

ZeynaBundle.name: Zeyna's Bundle
ZeynaBundle.desc: Herbs, tied with string. For Nadira. 'Tell her I said the weather is changing.'

GullKey.name: Brass Gull Key
GullKey.desc: A brass key stamped with a gull. It was under the well stone.

LedgerPage.name: Torn Ledger Page
LedgerPage.read:
A page torn from an account book. A column of dates, all from 4E 173. A column of sums, large ones. A column of initials:

T.H.
B.K.
I.Q.
S.D.
F.A.
V.
A.K.

The last initials are written much larger than the rest, and pressed so hard the nib went through the paper.

SaltHookSeal.name: Salt-Hook Seal
SaltHookSeal.desc: Bahram's. A fish-hook in a grain of salt, cut in iron. It will open a door somewhere.

Folio.name: Folio One
Folio.read:
PAYMENTS, HEGATHE ROAD, 4E 173.

Thirty-one pages in a small, careful hand. Names of families. Numbers of children. Beside each, a sum in Aldmeri gold, and a signature: A. Kerrash, Captain.

The last page, in a different hand, a child's hand grown up: 'I was number nineteen. I kept this so somebody would have to answer for it. N.'

TaxLedger.name: Tarik's Accounts
TaxLedger.read:
The Patriot's Share, Saltreach, this season. Two columns. One is what was collected. The other, much longer, is what was 'sent on'. Every line sent on is marked with a small hook.

Folded inside, a letter: 'T. The Haddads were late. See to it, and see the woman on the hill is not. B. will come with you. Be pleasant. K.'

TaxLedgerKey.name: Tax House Key
TaxLedgerKey.desc: Tarik's key to the tax house strongbox.

KeshLetter.name: Letter to Bahram
KeshLetter.read:
Bahram. The farmer lived. That was the point, but he is not behaving like a messenger. If he comes to the stair, do not make him a martyr. Break his hands and send him to Sentinel. I want to see what he does next.

The weather is changing. K.

BanditNote.name: Bandit's Orders
BanditNote.read: Qadir. The Kesh pay for every cart that does not reach Saltreach. Don't touch the riders with the blue hoods. Don't touch the salt carts with the hook on them. Everything else is yours.

SmugglerNote.name: Smuggler's Note
SmugglerNote.read: Juma says the cave is finished. Too many skeevers and too many eyes. Move the rest to the Redtide boats at the new moon. Leave the potions, they're watered.
